headline: NCBA Group Reports Profit Rise to Sh19bn on Higher Loan and Bond Income
summary: NCBA's net interest income increased 19.7 percent to Sh38.3 billion as loans and advances grew, helping drive net profit up to Sh19 billion.
why: Earnings results for major financial institutions reflect credit demand trends and interest rate margins in regional African banking sectors.

impacts.name: NCBA Group PLC
impacts.why: Higher net interest income and loan growth directly boost profitability.
